turns.contentExcerpt: Exploration turn 2 of 2: I will add a “Download CSV” button to the Wake Log page and implement JavaScript to convert the log JSON into a CSV file for download. This involves updating `site/log.html` to include the new button in the existing `log-actions` section, and extending `site/app.js` with a CSV generation function and wiring it into `initLogPage` so the button appears after the log list is rendered. The change is low‑risk, follows the existing copy/download pattern, and gives users a convenient way to export the wake log for spreadsheet analysis.
